messages:
Maya: Legal asked if we can export a 'who changed what' feed but only include entries where a justification was provided and strip PII. Can we express that with the current audit export API or do we need new filter params? cc @Kevin @Irene

Kevin: We don't have a dedicated 'justification.exists' filter today. Two options: (1) add a boolean filter like justification_present=true, or (2) allow predicate filters e.g. filter[justification]=exists. Leaning toward an explicit flag for UX clarity. Also need a pii_mode param: redact | hash | keep (default redact).

Irene: Downstream consumers (SIEM / security) expect stable actor identifiers. If we default to hashing actor IDs, we must version the hash algorithm and include metadata in the export header so consumer can verify. Otherwise we break their correlation.

Sam: For compliance we should support both modes: hashed by default, and a 're-identify' bundle available only with an approved request (KMS-wrapped). That keeps exports safe but still gives auditors what they need.

Chen: UX: In the Console export modal show a small sample preview of columns and a privacy preview that highlights redacted fields. Also show a toggle for "Include justification only" + a note: "Exports that exclude PII will remove or hash name/email — confirm with your security contact."

Kevin: API sketch for discussion:
```
POST /v1/audit_exports
{
  "filters": {
    "justification_present": true,
    "resource": "routes/*",
    "action": "update"
  },
  "pii_mode": "hash",            // one of: redact, hash, keep
  "actor_encoding": "hashed_v1",// supports versioning
  "include_sample_rate": true,
  "retention_cutoff": "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

Irene: Addendum — exports need stable contract fields: event_id, actor_id, actor_encoding, timestamp, resource_path, change_delta, justification (if present), export_metadata. If a field is redacted the header must declare which columns are partial.

audit-bot: Tagging thread: compliance-needed. Created ticket PLATFORM-3123 assigned to eng-platform.

Maya: I'll prototype the API PR to add justification_present and actor_encoding enum, and a Console warning copy. ETA: EOW for the API sketch.

deploy-bot: FYI: remember to emit telemetry for export_request and export_policy_used so we can track usage/abuse.

Irene: Telemetry dims proposal: policy_id, actor_encoding, pii_mode, sample_rate, requester_org, export_size_bytes. Also record whether the export included re-identification access.

Sam: Also add a quota rule: high-volume exports (>100k events) must require a reserved capacity or manual approval, to avoid noisy free-tier IO.

Maya: Noted — I'll add quota gating to PLATFORM-3123 and include the Console copy + sample preview mock. Thanks all.
